About the role
GRID is looking for a BI Analyst to join our Trading team and support esports trading operations through data, reporting, and statistical tools. The core focus of this role is to build and maintain statistical modules for traders and provide clear performance and actionable insights to trading.
You will work closely with traders, analytics, and data teams to ensure trading decisions are supported by accurate, timely, and actionable data.
